hole-io.title: Hole.io Game: Play Online for Free - Devour the World
hole-io.slogan: Devour the World and Dominate the Black Hole Universe in Hole.io!
hole-io.description: Dive into Black Hole Wars Hole.io! Control a hungry black hole, devour everything from trash cans to cities. Enjoy personalized skins and dominate the Hole.io universe. Play now!

HomeIframe.title: Hole.io
HomeIframe.description: Control a black hole and devour everything in your path!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: In Hole.io, transform into a hungry black hole and begin your journey to devour everything, from roadside trash cans to skyscrapers and entire cities!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Control your black hole using the on-screen joystick.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Devour smaller objects to grow bigger.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Compete against other players to become the biggest black hole in the city.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Similar to the snake eating game but more exciting!
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Make your black hole unique and super eye-catching!
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Control a black hole and suck everything into the city!
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Compete with other players in real-time to dominate the arena.
